question: Which of the following is the horizontal distance between two successive crests?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wavelength**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The distance between two successive crests or troughs of sea waves is called the wavelength of a wave.**
 
• The wavelength of a wave is the distance between any two corresponding points on adjacent waves.
